_about: Public-domain Wayland Hoyt (1838-1910), Baptist pastor in Cincinnati, Brooklyn, Philadelphia and Minneapolis, for the Word Hoard: Hints and Helps for the Christian Life, a YMCA sermon, Present Lessons from Distant Days, Gleams from Paul's Prison, Along the Pilgrimage, The Brook in the Way, Saturday Afternoon, For Shine and Shade, Helps Upward, and The Teaching of Jesus concerning His own Person. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 95 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
